name: Fundamentals of Investing
description: Introduces topics relevant for students who want to understand the modern framework for evaluating investment opportunities. Combines key elements of managerial accounting and finance, as well as modern portfolio and asset pricing theory. Students learn to apply the core tool of analytic finance to assess the value of company projects, including those undertaken by start-ups, and to analyze financial market conditions to recommend investment strategies. (For non-ESD students only.)
